query: SELECT p.id, p.name, p.slug, pi.color, pi.imageUrl FROM products p JOIN productImages pi ON p.id = pi.productId WHERE pi.color IN ('black', 'white', 'navy', 'Black', 'White', 'Navy') AND p.id IN (1, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70) ORDER BY p.id, pi.color LIMIT 30
